question.text: Same cross-asset risk appetite long → is the Shanghai composite close 5 A-share sessions later above the basis close?
factors: The signal is untouched: four US cross-asset factors, 90th percentile of expanding history
Add: within 3 days before CPI, or 3-7 days before NFP, with the score at or above the median
Remove: no point on the FOMC decision day, and no point on days with a strong bearish surprise
question.rule: Nothing in the signal changes. A US signal dated D is known at 04:00 Beijing the next morning, so the first A-share session after D is the one that settles it. That session's close is the basis of the call; the call is a hit if the close 5 A-share sessions later is above it. The open of that session is recorded as `entry` — the price you could actually pay — but it does not decide the call.

contexts.label: Cross-asset composite (4 factors)
contexts.note: z-score of yields, dollar, credit, VIX; signal above the 90th percentile

contexts.label: CPI window (3 days before)
contexts.note: score at or above the median within 3 days of a CPI release

contexts.label: NFP window (3-7 days before)
contexts.note: score at or above the median 3-7 days before payrolls

contexts.label: FOMC decision day
contexts.note: no signal on the day the Fed decides

contexts.label: News score — DeepSeek
contexts.note: one LLM read per day; a strong bearish surprise removes that day's signal (deepseek-chat)

contexts.label: News score — Strong bullish surprise
contexts.note: LLM reads a strong bullish surprise; adds a signal when price triggers did not fire

contexts.label: Keyword scan — Risk-off headlines (≥ 2)
contexts.note: regex scan hits 2 or more risk-off concepts in daily headlines

contexts.label: News score — Qwen · 3.8-flash
contexts.note: severity ≥ 0.6 on a labeled day removes that day's signal; 490 of 4632 days labeled (2002-01-03 → 2026-11-10), unlabeled days never veto

contexts.label: A-share trend filter — Below 20-day MA
contexts.note: 上证综指收盘低于 20 日均线时否决买入（本土趋势过滤）

contexts.label: A-share open gap > +1.0%
contexts.note: A 股次日高开超过 +1.0% 时否决追高

contexts.label: A-share 5-day pullback < -3%
contexts.note: 上证综指 5 日跌幅超 3% 时补一个超跌反弹信号
